notes.title: Good Doggo Devlog 01
notes.content:
Hey everybody! We've had a successful launch and we are super excited!

We sat down together to gather our thoughts on developing and releasing Good Doggo. You can check out the video here on the community page:

[url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=1376252269]https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=1376252269[/url]

Thanks for the support!
Bryan and Crista
Cozy Game Pals

notes.title: Patch Notes - Achievement Fix
notes.content:
Our community helped us track a bug where some people weren't getting their achievements.
The latest version of the game should have achievements working correctly.

Thanks for the help!
<3
